elementCoverage.note: Non-text elements (shapes, logos, decorative marks) are not individually segmented; a flattened render does not expose them. Only text is isolated, via OCR plus ink-boundary analysis.

media.backgroundTreatment: photographic or gradient background with to top darkening

masksOrCutouts.note: cannot be determined from a flattened render

shadows.note: photographic shading and layer shadows are indistinguishable in a flattened render

overlayGradient.note: Darkening estimated from image brightness only. It cannot be separated into 'photo shading' vs 'applied overlay layer' from a flattened render.

blur.note: not separable from a flattened render

blendMode.note: not recoverable from a flattened render

textureOrGrain.note: high-frequency energy proxy; photo detail and deliberate grain are not distinguishable

dropShadowOnText.note: a large positive delta on light text suggests either a shadow/scrim or naturally darker artwork behind the text; not separable here

backgroundApproximation.accuracy: APPROXIMATE — reconstructed, not the original asset
backgroundApproximation.method: vertical neighbour interpolation over text spans + local blur

missing.reason: Pixy API exposes only a flattened render; no layer/asset endpoint exists

limitations: Pixy exposes no per-element/layer endpoint, so all geometry is derived from pixel analysis of the flattened render rather than read from design data.
Font families are authoritative (declared by Pixy); size, weight and tracking are fitted and carry an IoU-based confidence score.
Layer opacity, blend modes and true overlay alpha cannot be recovered from a flattened render.
background-approx.png is reconstructed and must never be treated as exact.

fontFamily.confidence: authoritative — supplied by the Pixy API, not inferred

fittedMetrics.how: candidate renders scored by scale-normalised IoU against the reference glyph ink
fittedMetrics.caveat: IoU is a conservative lower bound on fit quality. Alternative metrics were trialled and performed worse; see BATCH-REPORT.md.
